end.summary:
Practised representing 14 as one bundle of ten and 4 loose sticks.
Saanvi identified the bundle as ten and counted 4 loose sticks.
They said the total was 14 after discussing the bundle method.
Place-value meaning of the digits 1 and 4 remained unclear.
Lesson stopped when Saanvi asked to stop.
end.parentNote: Saanvi practised making 14 with one group of ten and four ones. Using the sticks helped them say “one ten and four” and reach 14, though they still mixed up the digit 1 with one single object; this was not fully corrected by the end. At home, make numbers 11–20 with ten buttons in one group plus loose buttons, and say “one ten and ___ ones” together.
